comments.label: range Metric
comments.text: This whole section, from the separation dynamic chart downwards, is not matching the style and functionality of the E-002 full viz, still. This is frustrating. I don't know how to be clearer with you on this.

comments.label: separation Chart
comments.text: Because GEO timescales are different than LEO ones, you need to show much more than a day on the x-axis of this dynamic chart. Try a week.

comments.label: 3D globe
comments.text: Please delete the geostationary reference orbit. To better match E-002, you should be highlighting the orbit of the satellite at the center of the reference frame instead.

comments.label: mode Btn
comments.text: Clicking this button is supposed to show an ECI view, in which the camera is on the vector normal to the orbital plane, but zoomed out so you can see everything.

comments.label: playback Dock
comments.text: If there are only two chapters, the toggle box here should be formatted such that those two toggle switches fill the entire width.

comments.label: slider Now
comments.text: This is supposed to be more complete date and time.

comments.label: playback Dock
comments.text: These toggle labels should say the complete date.

comments.label: 3D globe
comments.text: On the changing-chapter sequence, the rightward arrow between the two dates is missing. Also true on E-002.
